newsitem.title: USA: Robbins & Myers offering $60 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Robbins & Myers offering $60 mln in notes.

text.p: Robbins & Myers Inc said Thursday it had issued a public offering of $60 million of its convertible subordinate notes, a $10 million increase in the notes originally registered in August.
The notes, which are due 2003, are convertible into common shares of the company at an initial conversion price of $27.25 per share.
Robbins & Myers said it is granting the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional $5 million of the notes to cover over-allotments.
Robbins & Myers manufactures and markets fluid-management products and services.
